quotes.text: Capturing all the action and dramatic exhibition of sports entertainment, the Mattel WWE Elite features authentically sculpted 6 inch figures of the biggest WWE Superstars.
Figures feature deluxe articulation, amazing detail and accessories such as masks, armbands and costumes.
Boogeyman (Flashback Series) (First Time in the Line), Cactus Jack (Flashback Series), Dean Ambrose, Dolph Ziggler, Erick Rowan, Kalisto

WWE Elite Series 48 was released in 2017 and consists of 6 figures: 1. Boogeyman (Flashback Series) (First Time in the Line) 2. Cactus Jack (Flashback Series) 3. Dean Ambrose 4. Dolph Ziggler 5. Erick Rowan 6. Kalisto. The pre-order date was February 7th, 2017, with a release date of March 2017, and the configuration was 8 pieces per case.
